evidence: Modifies test/functional/test_framework/crypto/secp256k1.py to optimize pure-Python elliptic curve math used across functional tests.
rationale: Substantially cuts runtime for crypto-heavy functional tests like feature_taproot.py. The author and reviewers measured feature_taproot.py running roughly twice as fast (dropping from ~83s to ~35s on macOS and 51.6s to 27.6s on Linux), reducing functional test suite runtime.
